outcome: A project can select Scrum, Kanban, hotfix, or research templates besides the built-in user-story template
acceptance: the catalog lists user-story, Scrum, Kanban, hotfix, and research built-in templates
selecting Scrum plans a new WorkItem with Scrum steps
selecting Kanban plans a new WorkItem with Kanban steps
selecting hotfix plans a new WorkItem with hotfix steps
selecting research plans a new WorkItem with research steps
an existing open run keeps its previous template after the project selects another
customers cannot select a project workflow template
inScope: built-in Scrum, Kanban, hotfix, and research workflow templates
planning a WorkItem from the selected template
keeping an open run on its original template version
outOfScope: per-WorkItem-type, Milestone, risk, or delivery-slice template override
assumptions: the built-in user-story template, clone, select, replace, and plan already exist
visual designer and Test Lab stay in later D rows
